statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.description: Loses 3 health at the start of each of their turns, for 3 turns. A second application stacks it once.

statuses.name: Exposed
statuses.description: Takes 25 percent more damage. Lasts 2 turns.

statuses.name: Enraged
statuses.description: Deals 30 percent more damage and takes 15 percent more. The sample applies it for the rest of a fight.
